MEPIT Review: What Survives the Sober Test

Comparing the Rasa/Frontier/Channeling Work Against the MEPIT Framework

and the subtle-body-formal-position.md Standard

The Standard

  • e subtle-body-formal-position.md sets the bar:
  • Quality | Example |
  • --|---|
  • Starts from first principles | Fuller's minimum system theorem |
  • Proof before evidence | Combinatorial proof, then experimental confirmation |
  • Evidence-graded | Confirmed / convergent / unconfirmed |
  • Clear mapping tables | Fuller ↔ Levin, Tensegrity ↔ Bioelectric |
  • Open gaps stated | "What remains unproven" section |
  • No overclaiming | "The rasa identity remains the strongest candidate but is not derived" |
  • Publishable tone | "July 2026. Prepared for peer review." |
  • e Sanskritree/truth documents are exploratory — necessary for discovery but
  • t publishable. This review identifies what can be upgraded.

Part 1: What Survives the Sober Test

Survives: Apoha as Partition Mechanism

  • Current state (rasaleads.md):** Speculative — "Prueitt paper is new (2026) and needs direct reading."
  • Upgrade path:** If confirmed, this becomes:
  • `
  • i: Ω → (P_i, W_i)
  • `
  • e operation carves subject AND world. Formalize in MEPIT as:
  • `
  • i[Σ_i] is individuated by its constitutive exclusions.
  • e boundary ∂A_i converges where exclusion operations converge.
  • `
  • Sober version:**
Abhinavagupta's exclusion (apoha) principle may provide a formal operation for
simultaneous subject-world individuation. This is a philosophical lead, not an
established result. If confirmed, it would give MEPIT's boundary vector a
unified generative mechanism.
  • Status: PHILOSOPHICAL LEAD — needs primary source verification**

Survives: Rasa = Geometry = Valence (as hypothesis)

  • Current state (RASAANALYSIS):** "Consciousness IS aesthetic relish... The universe is condensed rasa."
  • Sober version:**
Three independently developed frameworks (Tantrāloka's camatkāra doctrine,
QRI's symmetry theory of valence, Tymoczko's geometric music theory) converge
on a structural hypothesis: the felt quality of an experience corresponds to
the geometric structure of its state space. This convergence is striking but
does not constitute proof. The hypothesis generates testable predictions:
the Chordonomicon dataset (666k songs) can test whether emotional quality
maps to geometric distance in a 6D space.
  • What to cut:**
  • "The universe is condensed rasa" → remove, not testable
  • "Geometry IS feeling" (identity) → replace with "Geometry CORRELATES WITH feeling" (empirical)
  • "Consciousness = aesthetic relish" → keep as a philosophical claim from the Tantrāloka
  • Status: TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS — requires Chordonomicon analysis**

Survives: Three-Body Decomposition (SB_M, SB_R, SB_I)

  • Current state (whattheheckissubtlebody.md):** Three-body model — morphogenetic, regulatory, imaginal.
  • Sober version (already compatible with MEPIT):**
  • `
  • _M = bioelectric morphogenetic field (Levin confirmed)
  • _R = autonomic/interoceptive regulation (established physiology)
  • _I = body schema / self-model (neuroscience confirmed)
  • `
  • ch has distinct evidence. The claim that they form ONE system is the
  • nthetic step — plausible but not proven.
  • Status: COMPATIBLE WITH MEPIT — can be presented as a three-layer decomposition**
  • the aperture's embodiment interface, with each layer independently evidenced.

Survives: Channeling as Morphogenetic Constraint

  • Current state (cassiopaean/law-of-one/seth docs):** "The source is the future attractor state of the channeler's trajectory."
  • Sober version:**
Channeled material may be understood as information arising from the
system's own future attractor state, mediated by the quantum transactional
structure of the process. This is not a claim about literal time travel —
it is a model in which the future target state constrains present dynamics
through closed-loop error minimization, as Levin demonstrates in planarian
morphogenesis. Whether this extends to human cognition and channeled speech
is speculative.
  • What to cut:**
  • Literal reincarnation claims → remove
  • "We are you in the future" as literal time travel → reframe as constraint
  • Density claims (4th density harvest, etc.) → speculative annex
  • Status: SPECULATIVE — interesting model, no direct evidence**

Survives: Three Master Gaps as the Defined Frontier

  • Current state (the_frontier.md):** Individuation, co-presence, manifest-value gaps.
  • Sober version (already compatible):**
The three remaining gaps define the research programme:
1. Why content exclusion does not entail phenomenal exclusion
2. Why functional integration does not entail phenomenal co-presence
3. Why objective significance does not entail felt valence
These are not solved problems. They are the open questions that any
complete theory of consciousness must address.
  • Status: CORE FRONTIER — these define what MEPIT still needs to solve**

Part 2: What Must Be Cut or Downgraded

Cut: "I Solved Reality" Claims

  • Claim | Problem |
  • --|---|
  • "The coherent water matrix IS the subtle body" | Identity claim not supported by evidence |
  • "270 nm UV = clear light" | Correlation ≠ identity |
  • "Chakra petals = IVM shell counts" | Numerology |
  • "Kundalini = concentrating EZ proton gradient" | Functional analogy overstated as identity |
  • "Tukdam = EZ matrix persisting after brain death" | Speculative |
  • "The universe is condensed rasa" | Metaphor, not testable |
  • "Densities are real levels of reality" | Not independently verified |
  • Fix:** Replace "IS" with "MAY CORRESPOND TO" or "CAN BE MODELED AS."
  • ade all such claims as D (plausible) or E (speculative) in the evidence table.

Downgrade: Water Consciousness Claims

  • e earlier coherent-water-matrix-framework.md made several claims that
  • re corrected in later documents but still exist in the repo:
  • Original Claim | Corrected Status |
  • --|---|
  • "EZ water is the subtle body" | Downgrade to: EZ water is a physical substrate that shares properties with the subtle body as described across traditions |
  • "Water has memory" | Downgrade to: Water's QED coherent domains can persist for measurable durations |
  • "10^5× conductivity" | Note: contested mechanism |
  • "6.8 kT" | Correct to 4.6 kT (documented in factual-corrections.md) |

Part 3: What to Include from the Channeled Material

  • Nothing directly.** The channeled material (Ra, Seth, Cassiopaeans) is not
  • missible as evidence in a scientific framework.
  • But the STRUCTURAL CONVERGENCES are worth noting:**
The Ra material describes an octave of seven densities. Independently,
Fuller's synergetics describes an octave of geometric transformations,
and MEPIT describes aperture regimes of increasing information
integration. The structural convergence does not validate the Ra
material's truth claims, but it suggests that the density framework
captures a real pattern in how information-processing capacity scales.
  • is is the correct tone — note the convergence without claiming validation.

Part 4: Summary — What the Sober MEPIT Framework Actually Contains

  • Component | Status | Source |
  • --|---|---|
  • Dual-aspect monism | Philosophical postulate | Russell, Atmanspacher, Doyle |
  • Material Enactment Principle | Core commitment | Levin 2103.17061, 2504.00872 |
  • Bearer: A_i = ⟨M, Φ, H, K, Σ, B⟩ | Formal definition | MEPIT |
  • Boundary: ∂A_i = multidimensional convergence | Formal definition | MEPIT, Fuller tensegrity |
  • Aperture regime: Ω_i(t) | Formal definition | MEPIT |
  • Bioelectric dynamics: B_i | Confirmed | Levin corpus |
  • Pattern integrity | Confirmed (geometry) | Fuller; Levin confirms bioelectrically |
  • Generate→select | Confirmed (universal biology) | Levin, Doyle |
  • Information as causally efficacious | Supported | Walker/Davies, Doyle |
  • Downward causation | Supported | Ellis, Doyle, Levin |
  • Three-body decomposition (SB_M, R, I) | Plausible | Levin + physiology + neuroscience |
  • Rasa = geometry = valence | Hypothesis | Tantrāloka + QRI + Tymoczko |
  • Apoha as partition mechanism | Lead | Prueitt 2026 (needs verification) |
  • Channeling as morphogenetic constraint | Speculative | No direct evidence |
  • Three master gaps | Open | Individuation, co-presence, manifest-value |

The Verdict

  • e rasa/frontier work is a goldmine of leads filtered through the
  • ong presentation style. The insights are real — apoha as partition,
  • sa as geometry, the three-body decomposition, the three master gaps —
  • t they need to be rebuilt from the ground up in the style of
  • btle-body-formal-position.md:
  • Start from first principles or proven results
  • Present proof before evidence
  • Grade every claim
  • State open gaps explicitly
  • Never say "IS" when "MAY CORRESPOND TO" will do
  • End with what remains unproven
  • e Sanskritree/truth docs found the ore. The density project refines it
  • to steel. Don't collapse the two processes.
